title: An outside row drains a real upstream-bug task graded by the held-back fix test
body:
Why: Fable 1115a slice 1; every outside row so far drains only the bootstrap first-test task.
Outcome: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts takes --task-file seeding one fixed-issue task per public row (a small upstream bug; the fix commit test is held back as hidden grader); summary gains a hidden column.
Proof: three public rows drain 0 and the hidden upstream test passes on the merged SHA. Paid about $0.15 per row. Public-source copies only.

Proof: three public fixed-issue rows drain 0 and the held-back upstream test passes on the merged SHA: php 4dccca0 (igorw/get-in fix 5d8383e), npm ebefbc2 (thlorenz/parse-link-header fix 0ac00b1), py b16c462 (saulpw/unzip-http fix 3c0918f). Run: node scripts/outside-acceptance.ts --task-file scripts/outside-hidden/tasks.json.
